title: Stereotype Detection in LLMs: A Multiclass, Explainable, and Benchmark-Driven Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM text generations from stereotype-eliciting prompts using a fine-tuned multiclass stereotype classifier (Multi-Grain Stereotype detector) to compute a deviation-based bias score compared to unrelated content.
